easyfarm.title: Easy Farm
easyfarm.button.reset.tooltip: Reset the playing loop to its first recording (/ef loop reset)
easyfarm.button.loop.tooltip: Play %s (stops any other loop). Click again to stop.
easyfarm.record.heading: Record input
easyfarm.record.description: Records every key, mouse button and camera movement. Recording pauses while any menu is open.
easyfarm.record.name: Recording name
easyfarm.record.key_hint: Tip: press %s anywhere to start or stop.
easyfarm.record.error.name_empty: Give the recording a name first.
easyfarm.record.error.name_too_long: That name is too long (max %s characters).
easyfarm.command.help.footer: Put names with spaces in quotes, e.g. /ef record "wheat farm"
easyfarm.command.help.open_tab: open the HUD on a tab
easyfarm.command.help.loop_reset: send the playing loop back to its first recording
easyfarm.record.paused_hint: Paused while this menu is open. Close it to keep recording, or stop and save now.
easyfarm.record.result.empty: Nothing saved: no keys were pressed and the camera did not move.
easyfarm.record.result.failed: Could not save the recording. See the log for details.
easyfarm.recordings.heading: Saved recordings
easyfarm.recordings.empty_hint: Record something in the Record tab and it will show up here.
easyfarm.recordings.open_folder.tooltip: Recordings are saved as JSON files in config/easyfarm/recordings
easyfarm.loops.heading: Loops
easyfarm.loops.empty_hint: Chain recordings together. A random buffer is added after each one.
easyfarm.loops.overlay.started_hold: %1$s ready. Hold left click to run, press %2$s to stop.
easyfarm.loops.result.left_world: Loop stopped: you left the world.
easyfarm.loops.result.busy_recording: Stop recording before starting a loop.
easyfarm.loops.result.missing: Can't start: %s recording(s) in this loop no longer exist.
easyfarm.loops.result.no_last_loop: Start a loop from the Loops tab first.
easyfarm.loops.editor.name: Name
easyfarm.loops.editor.order: Loop order · Hold = keep last keys pressed
easyfarm.loops.editor.error.name: Give the loop a name.
easyfarm.loops.editor.error.number: Buffer times must be numbers of seconds, like 0.5.
easyfarm.loops.editor.error.min: The shortest buffer must be at least %ss.
easyfarm.loops.editor.error.range: The longest buffer must be longer than the shortest, so it is always random.
easyfarm.loops.editor.error.max: The longest buffer can be at most %ss.
easyfarm.loops.editor.error.io: Could not save the loop. See the log for details.
easyfarm.loops.position.waiting_key: Cycle %s · %s · paused, press the loop key
easyfarm.loops.position.waiting_both: Cycle %s · %s · paused, hold left click or press the loop key
easyfarm.loops.setting.play_mode.tooltip:
Hold left click: a started loop runs only while left click is held and pauses in place when you let go.
Loop key (toggle): a started loop plays straight away; press %s to pause or resume it.
Either: both work.
easyfarm.loops.setting.background.toolti: While a loop is playing with the loop key, the game does not pause when its window loses focus. Does not apply to Hold left click, which cannot be held while tabbed out.
easyfarm.loops.overlay.started_key: Playing %1$s. Press %2$s to pause or resume.
easyfarm.loops.overlay.started_both: Playing %1$s. Press %2$s to pause or resume, or hold left click.
easyfarm.loops.editor.error.message: Type a message to send (up to %s characters, no special characters).
easyfarm.loops.result.left_garden: Loop stopped: you are not in the Garden.
easyfarm.loops.result.not_garden: Loops only play in the SkyBlock Garden.
